SQL Server Note
fields.options:
RFID SQL Agent — SQL Server Source

Polls a Microsoft SQL Server table where RFID/biometric terminals log swipes, and pulls new rows in order, tracking the last row imported so nothing is missed or duplicated.

Remote Sync Note
fields.options:
Push to a live/cloud site

If the campus SQL Server is only reachable from this machine (e.g. over a VPN a cloud-hosted site can't run), enable this to also forward every newly pulled punch to a remote SLCM site over its REST API, immediately after it's pulled here. Create an API Key/Secret on the remote site (User → API Access) and paste them below.

fields.description: Forward every newly pulled punch to the remote site below via its REST API.
fields.label: Enable Remote Push

fields.label: Remote Site URL
Student Map Note
fields.options:
Student Map links each card code in the device database (etpdb) to the Student Master record whose field below has the same value (by default the Student ID). Names are only a cross-check — leave Name Column(s) empty to match by Student ID alone (e.g. Table iclock_trans_ajim, Code emp_code).
Use Student Map Tools → Find Name Columns to see what the SQL login can read, then Student Map to preview before anything is saved.
Names need read access — SQL for the SQL Server admin
USE etpdb;
GO
CREATE VIEW dbo.personnel_names_ajim AS
    SELECT emp_code, first_name, last_name
    FROM dbo.personnel_employee;
GO
GRANT SELECT ON dbo.personnel_names_ajim TO ajim;
GO
Then set Names Table / View to personnel_names_ajim (or click Find Name Columns). Only these three columns are shared — same pattern as the existing iclock_trans_ajim view.

fields.description: Table or view in the device database the SQL login can read (e.g. personnel_names_ajim, or iclock_trans_ajim for codes only).
fields.label: Names Table / View

fields.description: Column with the code the card sends to the reader (same value as emp_code in swipes).
fields.label: Card Code Column

fields.description: One or more columns, comma separated; joined with a space to make the name. Leave empty to match by Student ID only (no name check).
fields.label: Name Column(s)

fields.description: Field name in Student Master that equals the card code. registration_id = Student ID.
fields.label: Match To Student Master Field
Ignore Case And Spaces When Matching

fields.description: Off: rows whose device name does not look like the Student Master name are held back for review.
fields.label: Map Even When Names Differ
